verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon). Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a capability of SaaS and API platforms, not of a chip. The evidence shows no credential or API-key system for the product, so the story falls outside this product's category.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
